speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Do you prefer to wear comfortable and casual clothes or smart clothes?

speaker: B
name: Mia
text: I prefer comfortable clothes, because they help me feel relaxed — like this shirt I'm wearing right now, it's really comfortable. And about appearance: comfortable doesn't mean not smart, you know? With the right matching, you can wear comfortable clothes and still look good. But for specific occasions — like a job interview, or an opportunity, or meeting someone important — wearing smart clothes matters too.
